'''Mrisst''' was a mid-sized [[Planet/Legends|planet]],<ref name="TLCS" /> located in the [[Fakir sector/Legends|Fakir sector]] of the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It had a mild climate, and its four continents were dotted with small lakes and rivers. Jungle made up the majority of the terrain, consisting of [[spinetree]]s, [[spirepine]]s, and a variety of other flora. It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Mriss/Legends|Mrissi]].<ref name="TLCS" />

Mrisst became a center of higher learning for many underprivileged youths [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxywide]]; its [[Mrisst Trade and Science Academy]], while not as prestigious as other universities, was an effective learning institution.<ref name="TLCS" />

==History==
Mrisst was discovered by the [[Tenth Alderaanian Expedition]] during the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] era. When [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanians]] arrived on the planet, the Mrissi boasted many different cultures but had yet to develop three dimensional art.<ref name="TLC">''[[The Last Command]]''</ref>

The planet was subjugated by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]] and thus eagerly joined the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] later.<ref name="TLCS" /> In [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]], during the New Republic [[Core Campaign|campaign]] to liberate [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] [[Battle of Mrisst (6 ABY)|stopped]] an incursion of [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]]'s [[Zsinj's Empire|forces]] above Mrisst.<ref name="WG">''[[X-Wing: Wedge's Gamble]]''</ref>

Mrisst was [[Battle of Mrisst (9 ABY)|recaptured]] by [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] during his [[Thrawn campaign|campaign]], who used it as a staging area for his final assaults leading up to his [[Siege of Coruscant|surprising attack]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="TLCS" /> Ten years later, the New Republic used the Mrisst system as a staging area for an [[Battle of Yaga Minor (Galactic Civil War)|attack]] on [[Yaga Minor/Legends|Yaga Minor]].<ref name="VotF">''[[Vision of the Future]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The PC game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] mistakenly places the Fakir sector and, consequently, Mrisst, in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Galactic Core]].
